name: Clonazepam
description: Clonazepam (Klonopin) facts: uses for panic disorder and seizures, dosing basics, risks, interactions, overdose, withdrawal, and legal access.
quick: Clonazepam (Klonopin) is a long-acting benzodiazepine used for panic disorder and certain seizure disorders. It is a Schedule IV controlled substance. It works well for many people but causes dependence, and it must be tapered rather than stopped suddenly.
facts: Panic disorder; seizure disorders (Lennox-Gastaut, akinetic, myoclonic, absence)
Use with opioids; misuse and addiction; dependence and withdrawal

blocks.p: Clonazepam is approved for panic disorder with or without agoraphobia, and alone or as an add-on for several seizure types, including Lennox-Gastaut syndrome and absence seizures.[[1]]
Off-label, it is sometimes used for REM sleep behavior disorder, restless legs, and akathisia.

The figures below come from the FDA-approved label and describe how prescribers typically use clonazepam. They are not personal dosing advice. A prescriber sets the dose for each person and adjusts it over time.[[1]]

sections.q: What are the risks and side effects of clonazepam?

boxed.title: FDA boxed warnings
items: Taking benzodiazepines with opioids can cause profound sedation, slowed breathing, coma, and death.[[2]]
Benzodiazepines can be misused and can lead to addiction, which raises the risk of overdose and death.[[3]]
Regular use can cause physical dependence. Stopping suddenly or cutting the dose quickly can cause withdrawal reactions, including seizures, that can be life-threatening.[[3]]

blocks.p: **Common side effects** include drowsiness, dizziness, poor coordination, fatigue, depression, and memory problems.[[1]]
**Suicidal thoughts:** like other antiseizure medicines, clonazepam carries a warning about a small increase in suicidal thoughts and behavior.[[1]]

sections.q: What does clonazepam overdose look like?

blocks.p: Clonazepam overdose causes deep drowsiness, confusion, poor coordination, slowed reflexes, and coma. With opioids or alcohol, breathing can stop.[[1]]

emergency.title: If someone may have overdosed
items: Call 911 if the person is unresponsive, hard to wake, or breathing slowly.
For advice when the person is awake and stable, call Poison Help at 1-800-222-1222 (US, free, 24 hours).
If opioids could be involved, including pills not from a pharmacy, give naloxone if you have it. Naloxone does not reverse clonazepam, but it will not harm the person.
Stay with the person and place them on their side if they are drowsy or vomiting.

sections.q: What is clonazepam withdrawal like, and how long does it last?

blocks.p: People who take clonazepam regularly, even as prescribed, can become physically dependent within weeks. Its long half-life means withdrawal often begins a few days after the last dose.[[3]]

timeline.title: Symptoms begin
timeline.text: Rebound anxiety, insomnia, restlessness, sweating, and tremor.

timeline.title: Acute withdrawal
timeline.text: Panic, irritability, muscle pain, nausea, sensitivity to light and sound, and in severe cases seizures or delirium.

timeline.title: Protracted symptoms in some people
timeline.text: A minority have lingering anxiety, poor sleep, low mood, or tingling that can last weeks to more than 12 months.

blocks.warn: Stopping clonazepam abruptly after regular use can cause seizures. The dose should be reduced gradually under the care of a prescriber.

blocks.p: The label advises lowering the dose by 0.125 mg twice a day every three days for panic disorder, but many people need a much slower taper. In people with epilepsy, stopping suddenly can trigger continuous seizures (status epilepticus).[[4]]

sections.q: How do you get clonazepam legally in the US?

blocks.p: In the United States, clonazepam is a Schedule IV controlled substance. The only legal way to get it is with a prescription from a clinician registered with the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), filled by a licensed pharmacy. Depending on state law, that can be a physician, nurse practitioner, or physician assistant.[[5]]

ul: **Refills:** a Schedule IV prescription can be refilled up to five times within six months of the date it was written. After that, a new prescription is needed.[[6]]

**Telehealth:** federal flexibilities let DEA-registered clinicians prescribe Schedule II to V medicines after a telemedicine visit, without a prior in-person exam, through December 31, 2026. A permanent DEA rule was under final review in late 2026. State rules can be stricter.[[7]]
**Monitoring:** prescribers and pharmacists in most states check a prescription drug monitoring program, a database of controlled-substance prescriptions, before prescribing or dispensing.

**Pharmacies:** a legitimate pharmacy always requires a valid prescription, has a licensed pharmacist available, and is licensed in the state it ships to. The FDA's BeSafeRx tool and the NABP's safe pharmacy list help confirm a pharmacy is real.[[8]][[9]]
**Cost:** generic clonazepam is inexpensive and widely covered.

blocks.warn: Pills sold as Klonopin outside a pharmacy are often counterfeit. The DEA reports that fake pills frequently contain fentanyl or methamphetamine, and they cannot be told apart by appearance.[[10]]

blocks.p: **Traveling:** keep the medicine in its original pharmacy container and carry a copy of the prescription. Check the rules of the destination country before travel, because many countries restrict controlled medicines or require a permit.

Yes, but only with a valid prescription and only from a pharmacy licensed in your state. Many licensed pharmacies, including mail-order pharmacies run by insurers, fill clonazepam prescriptions online and ship them. Buying clonazepam from a website that does not require a prescription is illegal, and the product is often fake.[[8]][[10]]

steps: A clinician evaluates you in person or by telemedicine and decides whether clonazepam is appropriate.
The prescription goes to a pharmacy
Prescriptions for controlled medicines are usually sent electronically, straight from the prescriber to the pharmacy you choose.
The pharmacy checks and fills it
A pharmacist verifies the prescription and your identity, then dispenses the medicine in person or by mail.

blocks.p: **Signs that an online seller is illegal:**

ul: It sells clonazepam with no prescription, or after only a short online questionnaire.
It takes orders through social media, messaging apps, or email.
It asks for payment in cryptocurrency, gift cards, or money transfers.
It has no US street address, no state pharmacy license, and no pharmacist to speak to.
Its prices are far below those of ordinary pharmacies, or it ships from another country.

blocks.p: The FDA's BeSafeRx tool links to each state's license lookup, and the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy lists verified online pharmacies.[[8]][[9]]

faq: Is clonazepam the same as Klonopin?
Yes. Klonopin is the brand name for clonazepam.
How long does clonazepam stay in your system?
Its half-life is 30 to 40 hours, so it takes about a week to clear. Urine tests can detect it for 5 to 10 days or longer.
Is clonazepam better than Xanax for panic disorder?
Clonazepam lasts longer, which avoids between-dose rebound anxiety. Both carry the same risks of dependence. Antidepressants and therapy are first-line treatments.
No. Stopping suddenly can cause severe withdrawal and, in people with epilepsy, prolonged seizures.
